data_fields.name: level_gap_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 6 levels either way; beyond it the exchange is 0

data_fields.name: offset_scalar_table
data_fields.donor_constant: 13 rows (gap -6..+6), win/loss pairs from [175,25] to [40,160]; 100/100 at gap 0

data_fields.name: min_exchange
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 when the result rounds to 0 or less

data_fields.name: level_xp_bands
data_fields.donor_constant: short table 0-2499 XP in 100s; then 500 XP per level from 2500; level 50 at 22500

best_idea: Rank a duel by one XP that moves by an outcome-by-level-gap table, gated at six levels apart, with a loser's loss scaled by the loser's own level, and settle both sides from the same pre-match XP.
decision_why: The ladder shape fits ranked 1v1 duels; the numbers are a ruleset to be data, and the donor's Find and award order defects must not be copied.
acceptance: A server test duels a 650-XP level-5 player against a 450-XP level-4 player: the winner gains 22 XP and the loser drops to 445 (-5), both computed from pre-match XP; a pair six or more levels apart exchanges no XP; a new player gets an entry and a returning player keeps their XP after a duel.
